forum.title: Any accelerometer supporting >400g with integrated free-fall detection ?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @David\_Thomas ,

At the moment, the only High G accelerometer we have is the one integrated in LSM6DV320X.
forum.content_text: Hi Team, do ST offer a high-g accelerometer, similar to the LSM6DSV320X on the STEVAL-MKI251A, that supports over 400g with integrated free-fall detection?
